name: OpenConditions Federation
description: Exchanges road and traffic conditions with pinned peer instances: serves this instance's actor document and signed outbox, takes peers' subscriptions and pushes to their inboxes, lands their records through the same admission as crowd reports, and keeps this instance subscribed to the peers it follows — all over the shared PostGIS `conditions` schema. Off until OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ENABLED is true; peers reach it only through a public route the operator provides (see docs/federation-onboarding.md).
author: OpenConditions

DATABASE_URL.title: Database URL
DATABASE_URL.description: Required. PostgreSQL/PostGIS connection URL of the shared database the ingest service writes, for the ingest service's role, e.g. postgresql://openconditions_ingest:<password>@openmapx-postgis:5432/openmapx. Never use the PostgreSQL superuser; create the role as OpenMapX's community extensions guide describes. The service refuses to start without it.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ENABLED.title: Federation enabled
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ENABLED.description: "true" turns federation on. Empty: off, and the federation routes answer 404.

OPENCONDITIONS_SECRETS_KEY.title: Secrets key
OPENCONDITIONS_SECRETS_KEY.description: Required when enabled. Copy the value of openconditions-ingest's Secrets key; never generate a new one. The instance's federation private keys are encrypted with it; without it a new instance key must be made, which changes this instance's federation identity and has every peer pin it again. Enabled, the service refuses to start with a key other than the one the ingest service holds, or one that cannot decrypt the stored instance keys. It is not recoverable from the OpenConditions tables: the copy in your recovery set is the ingest service's.

OPENCONDITIONS_INSTANCE_ID.title: Instance id
OPENCONDITIONS_INSTANCE_ID.description: Required. Copy the value of openconditions-ingest's Instance id, a lower-case DNS name such as maps.example.org; enabled, the actor's instanceId must equal it too. The service refuses to start without it, with a value that is not a DNS name, or with another id than the one the ingest service sealed in the database.

OPENCONDITIONS_SCHEMA_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Schema wait timeout (ms)
OPENCONDITIONS_SCHEMA_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: The ingest service migrates the database; this service waits at start until the schema is at its version or newer, and stops with what it expected and found after this long. Empty: 300000.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ACTOR.title: Actor config
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ACTOR.description: Required when enabled. This instance's actor config as inline JSON or a path to a JSON file: instanceId, baseUrl (the public origin peers reach the service at), operator, jurisdiction, coverage, licence, trust tier and capabilities.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_PEERS.title: Peers config
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_PEERS.description: The pinned peers as an inline JSON array or a path to a JSON file: each with instanceId, actorUrl, trustTier and pinnedKeys, and optionally subscribe (what to receive by push) and pull (what to read of its outbox with this instance's own cursor). Empty: no peers.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ARCHIVE_URL.title: Archive URL
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_ARCHIVE_URL.description: Where peers fetch the static archive of history beyond their live window, an http(s) URL the operator serves the ingest's archive directory at. Empty: <baseUrl>/archive.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_REGISTRY_URL.title: Registry URL
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_REGISTRY_URL.description: Where the federation registry is served, an http(s) URL with its TUF metadata under /metadata and its instance entries under /targets. The instances it lists, verified daily, join the configured peers. Empty: no registry.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_REGISTRY_ROOT.title: Registry root
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_REGISTRY_ROOT.description: Required with a registry URL. The registry's trusted root metadata (root.json), obtained out of band, as inline JSON or a path to the file.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_CLIENT_CERT_HE.title: Client certificate header
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_CLIENT_CERT_HE.description: For peers that require mutual TLS behind a TLS-terminating proxy: the request header the proxy puts a verified client certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint in. The proxy must set it itself and be the only way to the service. Empty: the service reads client certificates off its own TLS connections.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_CLIENT_CERT.title: Client certificate
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_CLIENT_CERT.description: For peers that require mutual TLS of this instance: the PEM client certificate it presents on every request to a peer. Needs the client certificate key. The other operator pins its SHA-256 fingerprint. Empty: no client certificate.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_CLIENT_KEY.title: Client certificate key
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_CLIENT_KEY.description: The PEM private key of the client certificate. The service refuses to start with one of the two missing or a key that is not the certificate's. Empty: no client certificate.

OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_TRUSTED_PROXIE.title: Trusted proxies
OPENCONDITIONS_FEDERATION_TRUSTED_PROXIE.description: The comma-separated addresses or subnets (10.0.0.2, 172.18.0.0/16) of the reverse proxies in front of the service. The client certificate header is taken only from them, and so is X-Forwarded-For, the client address anonymous outbox reads are rate limited by. Empty: the client certificate header from any connection, so the proxy must be the only way to the service, and every anonymous reader behind a proxy metered as the proxy's address.

OPENCONDITIONS_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Peer request timeout (ms)
OPENCONDITIONS_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long a request to a peer (its actor document, outbox, subscriptions or inbox) may take before it is abandoned. Empty: 60000.

OPENCONDITIONS_MAX_REDIRECTS.title: Peer request redirects
OPENCONDITIONS_MAX_REDIRECTS.description: How many redirects a request to a peer follows. Empty: 5.

OPENCONDITIONS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.title: Egress allowed private hosts
OPENCONDITIONS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated hostnames the egress guard lets the service reach although they resolve to private addresses, e.g. a peer on the same private network. Empty: none.
